name: The Scarlette Mage
source:
Set against the backdrop of autumn. Scarlette was always a drifter and daydreamer without any real destination in mind, but…

One day while she was out travelling in Mourningwood, she felt like she was finally getting closer to where she wanted to be.

However, unwanted pleasant memories from her troubled past begin to resurface after she encounters a certain supernatural creature named Ulan in the woods, who insists they've always been connected in some way, however… Scarlette remembers nothing at first other than flickering fuchsia colours and old lingering traces of arcane magic, because she suffers from retrograde amnesia.

Scarlette also encounters other otherworldly beings such as tree spirits (in the form of dryads) and a halfling from the elusive fairy grove, among other creatures—because of her unique ability to sense spirits, as well as fae.

Unfortunately for Scarlette, though… she is eventually confronted by her long buried past—and now… she and Ulan, as well as some other friendly faces they both run into will have no choice but to help her navigate this unfamiliar new reality.

Can she overcome her bleak past, while also growing stronger, and find a new purpose to existing? 

[From [url=https://citruskoi.itch.io/the-scarlette-mage]itch.io[/url]]
